create_KinematicHumanoid: create a KinematicHumanoid agent with agent config, simulator, and optional joint limits or fixed base
set_joint_transform: set the humanoid joint positions, offset transform, and base transform using set_joint_transform
get_joint_transform: get the current joint positions and base transformation of the humanoid via get_joint_transform
set_rest_position: set the humanoid agent back to its resting pose using set_rest_position
reconfigure_KinematicHumanoid: reconfigure the humanoid by loading URDF, setting kinematic motion type, and removing joint motors
